# Bundle

![Bundle function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/cluster/01-build-cluster.svg)

[Cluster functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Constructs an ordered heterogeneous Cluster, or replaces wired ordinal fields of the connected Cluster. References retain their complete type and target; this operation does not read Value.

## Studio authoring profile

Contract status: **partial**. The connector below describes Studio authoring; execution availability is stated separately.

<details>
<summary>Retained binding and help description</summary>

This is the source declaration, not the current measured product-execution assessment.

Positional Bundle with 1..32 configured elementN rows. An unwired optional cluster input constructs a heterogeneous Cluster in configured ordinal order with stable field IDs element1..elementN; every configured element must then be supplied. With a connected nonempty Cluster schema, wired positions replace corresponding fields and unwired positions preserve their values. The complete schema, nominal field IDs, names, nested schemas and typed reference objects are preserved. Extraction or replacement never reads a referenced control Value. No scalar, array or reference-to-data conversion is implied.

</details>

## Examples

These are real `.frog` documents from the same index used by Studio. Backend names and expected results describe the examples; they are not execution certificates.

- [Construct a heterogeneous Cluster](../../examples/cluster.bundle.construct.md) — Without an incoming Cluster, Bundle constructs its ordered heterogeneous schema. The Cluster keeps individual exact field values. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Replace one ordered Cluster field](../../examples/cluster.bundle.replace-one.md) — The incoming Cluster fixes its field order and types. Only the wired first field is replaced; the String and Boolean values remain unchanged. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Bundle — preserve-all](../../examples/cluster.bundle.preserve-all.md) — An incoming Cluster retains every unwired field. Replacement rows keep their semantic positions even when preceding or intervening rows are unwired. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Bundle — replace-middle](../../examples/cluster.bundle.replace-middle.md) — An incoming Cluster retains every unwired field. Replacement rows keep their semantic positions even when preceding or intervening rows are unwired. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Bundle — replace-outer](../../examples/cluster.bundle.replace-outer.md) — An incoming Cluster retains every unwired field. Replacement rows keep their semantic positions even when preceding or intervening rows are unwired. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
- [Unbundle derives its outputs from the incoming Cluster](../../examples/cluster.unbundle.schema-arity.md) — The saved node still records one historical row, while its actual incoming Cluster has three fields. Loading and compilation must expose all three outputs without changing that authored count or losing hidden fields. (`execution`, `studio-draft`).
